user.title: Set up SolarCost
user.description: Select four separate cumulative energy sensors in Wh, kWh or MWh (total or total_increasing). For power sensors, create Integral helpers first. Currency and the current Home Assistant time zone are fixed for this ledger. Tracking starts when setup is saved.

rates.title: Rates and reporting periods
rates.description: Prices include VAT by default. Enter {currency} per kWh (30 cents = 0.30). Standing charges and monthly levies are optional; leave them at 0 if unused. Only set the optional VAT adjustment when entering tax-exclusive prices. It applies to imports and fixed charges, never export credit. The discount applies only to imported energy. Last N months/years includes the current partial calendar period.

bands.title: Time-of-use bands
bands.description:
{bands}

Add as many non-overlapping bands as you need (up to 48), then Save.

band.title: Time-of-use band
band.description: Rates are in {currency} per kWh. Use whole minutes. Overnight bands belong to their starting weekday. Start is inclusive; end is exclusive. Both repeated daylight-saving hours use the same wall-clock tariff.

error.invalid_meter: Choose a non-SolarCost cumulative energy sensor with Wh, kWh or MWh units and a total or total_increasing state class.
error.duplicate_meter: Use a different sensor for each energy source.
error.invalid_currency: Enter a three-letter currency code, such as EUR, GBP or USD.
error.invalid_tariff: Enter finite rates, non-negative fixed charges, and percentages between 0 and 100.
error.invalid_band: Check the unique name, weekdays and whole-minute times. Bands cannot overlap, start and end must differ, and at most 48 bands are allowed.

init.title: SolarCost settings
init.description: Saved rate changes apply from reload onward. Existing charges are preserved. Changing a meter establishes a new baseline for that source.

meters.title: Energy meters
meters.description: Use separate cumulative energy sensors. Changing a source keeps recorded totals and establishes a new baseline.

get_report.name: Get bill report
get_report.description: Return energy and estimated charges for inclusive local dates, grouped by day, Monday-based week, month or year. Only recorded history is included.

end.name: End date
end.description: Last local calendar date, inclusive; today or earlier.
